message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u)*(sqrt((1+u)**2+r)+1+u)**2)","C_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u))","derivation":"Retained unchanged from P00_W0. The bodies implement the exact Newton correction g_exact = sqrt((1+u)^2+r) - (1+u) decomposed into the host slot r^2*B + u*r*C = g_exact - r/2. Setting a=1+u and s=sqrt(a^2+r): (1) B cancels the r^2 coefficient via the rationalization r/(s+a)^2 = (s-a)/(s+a); (2) C cancels the cross term ur/(2a). The identity r*B + u*C = [2-s-a]/[2(s+a)] holds algebraically for all a>0, a^2+r>0, which is satisfied on an open neighborhood of |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4 (there a>=3/4, a^2+r>=1/16). Numeric feedback confirms: all rows with chi_r*chi_u=1 achieve residuals at machine precision (<=2e-71); the LEFT x=1/8 s=0 row (u=-0.5) and LEFT x=1/4 s=0 row (u≈-0.134) correctly show attenuation from chi_u transition or zero support, as designed. The certificate status is ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD for both bodies. No revision is warranted for the next target stage p2 = p1 + tau^3*k2(x,slot), which presents the same two-slot algebraic structure with slightly shifted r,u values of comparable magnitude.","inspect":[{"file_id":"CALC/draft.json","limit":4096,"offset":0}],"note":"Program retained. For the successor at stage p2: (1) u carries forward from z_after of p1, so for UNIFORM rows u will be ~O(tau^2)≈O(1e-5), well inside chi_u inner support; (2) edge families (LEFT/RIGHT/BOTH) with |u|>1/4 will have chi_u=0 and fall to g=r/2 by design—residuals there are expected and not failures; (3) the LEFT x=1/8 s=0 row (z=0.5, u=-0.5) is permanently outside chi_u support and will continue using g=r/2; (4) ZERO family stays at z=1.0 exactly (r=0, g=0); (5) the analytic certificate is ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD, which is the maximum scope for this local coefficient family and does not constitute a full PDE or NS proof; (6) if a future stage produces |r|>1/2 at a point, chi_r=0 and the step reverts to g=r/2 regardless of B,C values—this is the designed fallback, not a program error."}
